name: bucketdesk
description: Browse, search, read and share files in the S3 buckets connected to your BucketDesk workspace.

interface.shortDescription: Work with files in S3 buckets
interface.longDescription: Browse folders, search file names across every connected bucket, read text files, ask questions about documents, create share links and run archive jobs in your BucketDesk workspace. Sign in with an Ultra workspace admin account.
defaultPrompt: Use BucketDesk to find last month's invoices in my buckets.
Use BucketDesk to summarize the contract PDF in my legal folder.
Use BucketDesk to create a share link for this file.

positive.description: Find a file by name across the connected buckets.
positive.prompt: Find the Acme contract in my buckets.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists contracts/acme-msa.pdf with its bucket name.

positive.description: Ask a question about a PDF document.
positive.prompt: What is the payment term in the Acme MSA?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers Net 30, quoting the payment term from contracts/acme-msa.pdf.

positive.prompt: Show me what's in the invoices folder.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the files under invoices/, including 2026-09-invoice-1042.pdf.

positive.prompt: Share the September invoice with theadonisking@gmail.com.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a share link that opens invoices/2026-09-invoice-1042.pdf.

negative.description: The plugin has no delete tool, so it explains it cannot delete files and nothing is removed.
The plugin has no upload tool, so it declines and suggests uploading in the BucketDesk app.
negative.prompt: Upload this spreadsheet to my bucket.

negative.description: The request is not about the user's files, so the plugin is not invoked.

publication.release_notes: Browse, search and read files in connected S3 buckets, ask questions about documents, create share links and run archive jobs. This version declares OAuth sign-in in mcp.json.
